command:
set -eu
cat > /usr/local/sbin/srvdata-loop-setup <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
image=/srv/.snapshot-storage/srvdata-pv.img
if ! /usr/sbin/losetup -j "$image" | /usr/bin/grep -q '^/dev/loop'; then
  /usr/sbin/losetup --find "$image"
fi
/usr/sbin/pvscan --cache >/dev/null
/usr/sbin/vgchange -ay vg_srvdata >/dev/null
ANTRIEB_EOF
chmod 0755 /usr/local/sbin/srvdata-loop-setup
cat > /usr/local/sbin/srvdata-loop-teardown <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
image=/srv/.snapshot-storage/srvdata-pv.img
/usr/sbin/vgchange -an vg_srvdata >/dev/null || true
loopdev=$(/usr/sbin/losetup -j "$image" | /usr/bin/cut -d: -f1 | /usr/bin/head -n1)
if [ -n "$loopdev" ]; then /usr/sbin/losetup -d "$loopdev"; fi
ANTRIEB_EOF
chmod 0755 /usr/local/sbin/srvdata-loop-teardown
cat > /etc/systemd/system/srvdata-loop.service <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Attach LVM backing store for /srv/data snapshots
DefaultDependencies=no
After=systemd-udev-settle.service
Before=local-fs-pre.target
Wants=systemd-udev-settle.service

[Service]
Type=oneshot
RemainAfterExit=yes
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/srvdata-loop-setup
ExecStop=/usr/local/sbin/srvdata-loop-teardown

[Install]
WantedBy=local-fs-pre.target
ANTRIEB_EOF
mkdir -p /srv/data
DATA_UUID=$(blkid -s UUID -o value /dev/vg_srvdata/data)
printf 'UUID=%s /srv/data xfs defaults,x-systemd.requires=srvdata-loop.service,x-systemd.after=srvdata-loop.service 0 0\n' "$DATA_UUID" >> /etc/fstab
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable srvdata-loop.service
mount /srv/data
restorecon -RF /srv/data 2>/dev/null || true
findmnt /srv/data
systemctl is-enabled srvdata-loop.service
